capabilities.problem: Stock research can produce a plausible literature list without explicit coverage obligations, evidence levels, decision history, or a reasoned stop decision.
capabilities.mechanism: Guide authored decomposition, frozen queries, saved backend receipts, version-bound source reviews, operational coverage and human actions through validation and checkpoint; live retrieval and scientific evaluation remain separate milestones.
